title: Bill Moore's spy training and Soviet postcard relays

tellings.quote: They had him like, you know, passing mail through and doing, you know, stuff with Soviet spies.

plain: A writer and researcher named Greg Bishop told podcast host Jesse Michels about Bill Moore, a UFO writer and researcher, in the early 1980s. According to Bishop, Moore was given a kind of spy training and was used to pass mail along and do other tasks involving Soviet spies. If true, it would mean a UFO researcher was being used in American intelligence work.
